law.catch_line: Notarial powers outside the Commonwealth for use in the Commonwealth

text.section: As used in this section, "notarial act" means an act, whether performed with respect to a tangible or electronic document, that a notary public commissioned in the Commonwealth may perform under the laws and regulations of the Commonwealth.

A document notarized outside the Commonwealth by a notary public or other person referenced in subsection B that appears on its face to be properly notarized shall be presumed to have been notarized properly in accordance with the laws and regulations of the jurisdiction in which the document was notarized.
